steps.name: rank
steps.title: Rank hypotheses
steps.detail: Abstain: The metrics show the drop began on 2024-05-17 and was uniform across every region, platform and channel. Payment attempts fell by about 37% while the payment failure rate stayed near 3%, so the loss is in checkout starts converting to payment attempts, not payment errors. No document describes a pricing change, outage, payment provider error, campaign end, or deploy that affects checkout at that time. The checkout-related tickets are unrelated questions, and the changelog entries (search ranking, notifications, help-page copy, log cleanup) do not touch checkout. The evidence is not enough to name a cause.

The fall came from fewer payment attempts after checkout starts, while payment failure rates stayed flat. No document in the evidence explains this drop, so no cause is named.
